deployments_detail.use: AI vessel-operations platform (with IBM, Jul 2026) integrating ship info for ~930 vessels; SOSC safety center
deployments_detail.value: crew scheduling -70%, anomaly detection 98%, est. ~JPY30bn/yr savings

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous collision avoidance and navigation support system; MOL conducted the world's first successful sea trial of an autonomous sailing vessel that integrated sensor data to navigate a safe route formulated by an autonomous collision-avoidance routing system.
AI-powered vessel allocation and cargo-loading optimization system for car carriers, using mathematical optimization to plan allocation of car carrier vessels across MOL's global network.

Deployed Sofar Ocean's Wayfinder dynamic voyage optimization platform across MOL Group fleet, providing daily optimal engine speed and route recommendations using high-precision weather forecasts to cut fuel and GHG emissions. [Sofar Ocean (Wayfinder)]
deployments_detail.value: average ~6% fuel/GHG emission reduction per voyage (trial with 40 vessels)

deployments_detail.use: FOCUS Project fleet performance management system: an integrated platform collecting up to 10,000 sensor data points per vessel across ~270 vessels, using AI/data analytics for vessel performance estimation and fuel-consumption reduction.

AI-powered vessel image recognition and recording system to support automated ship monitoring; uses a GPU-equipped terminal and high-resolution imaging to recognize and automatically record nearby vessels with high accuracy. Demonstration test on training ship Nippon Maru. [SenseTime Japan]

AI-powered vessel operations platform jointly developed with IBM Japan, integrating vessel operational data for 24/7 decision support; includes a generative AI assistant that identifies and extracts operational risks in real time by analyzing historical vessel records alongside current data. [IBM Japan]

AI routing engine developed with Bearing that automatically analyzes multiple potential routes for a given voyage and recommends prudent, efficient routing to reduce fuel consumption and emissions. [Bearing (AI)]

AI-powered optimization system for seafarer crew replacement planning, developed with Fujitsu; optimizes crew rotation planning to shorten consecutive onboard periods and improve seafarers' work-life balance. Full-scale trial operation began in Japan in May 2025. [Fujitsu]

AI initiative to forecast marine bunker (fuel) prices, developed via a joint study with Yokohama National University to analyze economic and maritime data and forecast ocean shipping/bunker market conditions. [Yokohama National University (joint study)]

MOL PEARL company-wide integrated data platform, the core of MOL's AI-driven DX initiative, designed to integrate and visualize data across the MOL Group to improve operational efficiency and support decision-making, enabling people and AI to collaboratively analyze data.

AI-based early fire/smoke detection system installed in car carrier cargo holds; cameras + AI analyze images to detect smoke faster than conventional alarms and alert onboard crew and onshore management. Deployed on LNG-fueled car carriers including CERULEAN ACE, which earned the world's first ClassNK notation for safe EV transport. [Captain's Eye (Israel)]
